item.description:
New • Spend alerts for a day or a month. Turn on Daily spend or Monthly spend in Settings and Actvt tells you once when your agents pass the limit you set. It counts every agent on this Mac and on your Remote Sessions hosts, at API rates. Monthly spend is part of Premium
Improved • Agents that ask Actvt over MCP now get replies they can read. A session list or a week of machine history used to be too big for Claude Code, so the agent got nothing. Lists now come back as compact tables in pages, and an agent can ask for only the parts it needs • Remote Sessions is much lighter on the host. Each minute, actvt-cli reads only the sessions that changed since the last check. It used to read all of them again. Hosts get this with actvt-cli 0.14.0 • A new or offline install prices long Codex prompts at their higher rate before it's fetched the latest prices

New • A loop that stops at a permission prompt now reads Waiting for input on the Loops card, right away, instead of working for hours. A loop whose agent is still running but has written nothing for 90 minutes reads Stalled. The card's header counts both with the overdue loops. Hosts get this with actvt-cli 0.13.0
Improved • A Claude Code session you named with /rename shows that name in Actvt, in the sessions list, its transcript, Remote Sessions and MCP. A rename late in a long session counts too. Clearing the name brings back Claude's own title, and a name you gave the session in Actvt still comes first. Hosts get this with actvt-cli 0.13.0

New • A reminder before a weekly limit resets with much of it unused. Turn on Weekly limit left unused in Settings, and Actvt tells you once, a day before the reset, when half or more of the week is still left. You can change both numbers
Improved • Every session shows its real message count. A long session used to show only what fit in its first part, so one with thousands of messages could read 200 • When one model's long-prompt price changes, Actvt re-reads only the sessions that used that model, not every session. The first launch of this update re-reads them once • Plan limits are fetched once at launch, not two or three times
Fixed • An update waiting to install no longer tries to while the welcome screen or another sheet is open. That attempt used to fail, the update then waited for the next launch, and quitting Actvt relaunched it hidden • Remote Sessions no longer shows a loop that runs in a sandbox as ended while it's working or asleep. Hosts get this with actvt-cli 0.12.0
